summary: Tested Recruiting Module improvements - Backend API tests (14/14 passed): team registration creates pending record, approval auto-creates team in league_data.teams + teams collection + coach user. Player application creates pending record, approval auto-creates user and adds to team roster. GET /api/join-us/applications?team_id={id} correctly filters by team. Frontend: Admin Portal -> Recruiting tab loads RecruitingManager component showing stats cards (8 team registrations, 11 player applications, 5 volunteer signups pending). Team Admin -> Recruiting sub-tab visible on team pages (tested on Lions page). Playwright had timing issues clicking sidebar elements due to scrolling ticker.

minor.issue: Returns created_team_id: null when rejecting instead of omitting the key (very minor)

critical_code_review_comments: joinus.py line 968-1090: update_team_registration correctly auto-creates team on approval - adds to both league_data.teams array and teams collection, creates coach user with proper teamAssignments
joinus.py line 1120-1212: update_player_application correctly auto-creates user and adds to team on approval with proper roles=['player'] and teamAssignments
RecruitingManager.js: Shows success messages when approving (line 76-78 for team, line 81-83 for player)
TeamRecruitingTab.js: Has section tabs for Applications and Invites (lines 214-231), loadAll fetches both invites and applications (lines 31-50)

success_rate.frontend: 90% - UI verified working, minor Playwright navigation timing issues

test_credentials: Admin user: set via localStorage mlbl_current_user with role='admin'. Coach user: teamId='eagles_01', roles=['coach']
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed registrations and applications during testing. Note: No delete endpoint for registrations so test data remains in DB but marked with TEST_ prefix
context_for_next_testing_agent: Recruiting module fully tested. Backend endpoints verified: POST /api/join-us/team-registration, PUT /api/join-us/registrations/{id}, POST /api/join-us/player-application, PUT /api/join-us/applications/{id}, GET /api/join-us/applications?team_id={id}. Frontend: Admin Portal -> Recruiting tab shows RecruitingManager. Team page -> Team Admin -> Recruiting shows TeamRecruitingTab. Existing teams: eagles_01, hawks_01, lions_01, tigers_01, plus TEST_ teams created during tests.
